Match options

Choose who plays each seat. Human players take turns on this device and pass it on when their turn ends. AI seats play by themselves.

You have 10 slots. Each hero takes 1-4 slots by its gold price (3-4g: 1, 5-6g: 2, 7-8g: 3, 9-10g: 4) and bosses take 5. Duplicates allowed. You spawn them next to your towers during the game. Squads spawn as 3 units. Each hero can move or act once per turn, not both. Be the last player standing. Towers have 12, 14 and 15 HP (left to right). From round 14 (sudden death; round 56 on larger maps) every tower crumbles each round.

1-5 pick reserve · Tab next hero · Esc cancel · E end turn · right-click to deselect
